items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And then we had a few numbers like trees and Martha and all, which are a fine number. We sort of played those too.

ctx.x: Here we go. We're on reel three of Luke's Giro. And we were talking about legends and the different tunes and things there. What are the people like there mostly? What kind of tunes they

would ask you for? Well, if they ask for some of the new ones and some of the old ones, some Latin American. It all depends on the crowd. Then you might get an Italian ship in there with some seamen and they'll ask for all the Italian numbers. And all we know is a few of them, like Omarie and Osolamé and a few others. So we tried to please them. And then we had a few numbers like trees and Martha and all, which are a fine number. We sort of played those too. That's our numbers and sometimes they ask for them too.…
